{{External|rs|rsc}} {{otheruses|def=no|battlestaves in general|Battlestaves}} {{Infobox Item |name = Battlestaff |image = [[File:Battlestaff.png]] |release = [[18 March]] [[2002]] |update = Latest RuneScape News (18 March 2002) |members = Yes |quest = No |tradeable = Yes |equipable = Yes |stackable = No |noteable = Yes |options = Wield, Drop |examine = It's a slightly magical stick. |value = 7000 |weight = 2.267 |exchange = Yes |id = 1391 }} [[File:Battlestaff detail.png|left|120px]] A '''battlestaff''' is a [[Members|members-only]] [[Weapons#Magic%20weapons|magic weapon]] which provides standard magical bonuses, heightened melee bonuses, and the [[autocast]] option when equipped. It requires 30 [[Attack]] and 30 [[Magic]] to wield. Due to not having any [[Elemental staves|elemental]] features, this staff has limited long-term use. Its advantage over [[Elemental staves|basic tier elemental staves]] and other lesser staves are its melee and magic bonuses. The staff can be purchased from [[Zaff's Superior Staffs!]] in [[Varrock]] after the completion of the quest [[What Lies Below]], and he'll stock 15 to 120 extra staves daily for players who have fully completed task tiers of the [[Varrock Diary]] (they can be obtained by interacting with the barrel in the north-west corner of the shop). The magic store owner in the [[Wizards' Guild]] and [[Baba Yaga]] on the [[Lunar Isle]] also stock them. It can also be bought on the [[Grand Exchange]], obtained through other players, dropped by various enemies, or fletched from [[Celastrus bark]] with level 40 [[Fletching]]. Battlestaves can be used to make [[elemental battlestaves]]. By using the appropriate ([[Charge Air Orb|air]], [[Charge Water Orb|water]], [[Charge Earth Orb|earth]], [[Charge Fire Orb|fire]]) charge orb spell on an [[Obelisk]] with an [[unpowered orb]] in their [[inventory]], a player can make an elemental orb, which can then be used on a battlestaff to make the corresponding elemental battlestaff. Elemental battlestaves can be upgraded to [[mystic staves]] by giving {{Coins|40000}} to [[Thormac]] after the completion of the quest [[Scorpion Catcher]]. After completion of the [[Hard Kandarin Diary]] and [[Elite Kandarin Diary]], Thormac will only require {{Coins|30000}} and {{Coins|20000}} respectively.
